description:
**Job Summary**

This hybrid Product Test Engineer role focuses on validating complex health care administration solutions built on Facets and TriZetto Elements for payer and provider clients. The engineer will design and execute robust functional and integration tests for enrollment benefit configuration and claims workflows ensuring high reliability and regulatory compliance. The role impacts health plan members and care providers through improved accuracy reduced processing defects and enhanced digital

**Responsibilities**

* Design comprehensive test strategies and detailed test scenarios for Facets enrollment workflows that ensure accurate member intake processing and reduce downstream defects in payer and provider operations.
* Develop and maintain reusable test cases and data sets for Facets benefit configuration that validate complex plan designs and improve reliability of benefit administration for diverse health plan offerings.
* Execute functional integration and regression testing for Facets claims processing to confirm correct adjudication logic and to minimize claim payment errors that impact providers and members.
* Coordinate end to end test cycles across Facets and TriZetto Elements modules to verify seamless data flow between enrollment benefits and claims components within integrated product releases.
* Analyze production like defects and root causes in payer and provider use cases and translate findings into targeted regression coverage and improvements in test design for future releases.
* Collaborate closely with product managers business analysts and configuration teams to clarify requirements and ensure test conditions accurately reflect real world payer and provider scenarios.
* Create and refine test data that mirrors complex provider networks member benefit combinations and claim scenarios to strengthen test depth and increase confidence in product behavior under varied conditions.
* Document clear test results defect details and impact assessments that help development and configuration teams resolve issues quickly and maintain high quality standards for client delivery.
* Use domain knowledge of payer and provider processes to validate compliance with business rules contractual obligations and regulatory expectations within Facets and TriZetto Elements solutions.
* Support performance and volume oriented test activities by modeling realistic enrollment loads benefit updates and claim submission patterns that reflect large scale health plan operations.
* Engage with implementation and support teams in a hybrid work model to review client specific configurations and share test insights that reduce implementation risk and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of test frameworks checklists and best practices for Facets and TriZetto Elements testing to improve efficiency and consistency across product releases.
* Mentor junior test engineers in understanding payer and provider workflows and in applying structured test design techniques that raise overall team capability and product quality.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate strong hands on experience in Facets enrollment testing with detailed understanding of member eligibility rules group structures and related configuration impacts on downstream processes.
* Apply advanced knowledge of Facets benefit configuration by designing tests that cover complex benefit hierarchies accumulators and cost sharing rules for varied health plan products.
* Utilize practical expertise with Facets claims modules to verify claim pricing accumulation and payment rules while ensuring alignment with payer reimbursement policies and provider contracts.
* Bring working experience in TriZetto Elements to validate integration points configuration consistency and data exchange between TriZetto tools and core Facets components.
* Exhibit solid domain understanding of payer operations such as enrollment premium handling benefits administration and claims adjudication to design realistic and business relevant test scenarios.
* Apply provider domain knowledge to test scenarios involving provider contracting reimbursement patterns and network participation attributes reflected in claims and benefit configuration.
* Use strong analytical and problem solving abilities to interpret complex defects reproduce issues reliably and recommend test coverage enhancements based on observed patterns in health care data.

* Leverage telemetry data, NetFlow, and streaming logs to build predictive baselines, optimize bandwidth usage, and forecast capacity

* Configure and troubleshoot complex Layer 2 and Layer 3 policies, including BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, BFD, QoS, and IPsec/GRE encapsulation

title: Senior Infrastructure Platform Engineer
description:
About the Role
  
We are seeking a hands-on Infrastructure Engineer to focus primarily on capacity and demand planning across data centers and public cloud. You will combine practical infrastructure experience with analytical thinking and strong internal customer relationships to translate future demand into clear capacity models, options, and timely decisions. This is a hands-on planning role grounded in how production infrastructure actually performs.
  
  
You will proactively engage engineering, application, product, and business teams, and help drive capacity and cost discussions with our existing FinOps engineers. Leadership owns approved forecasts, procurement and investment recommendations and decisions, and team backlog priorities. You provide the evidence, facilitate the planning cadence, and surface issues early.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Build trusted relationships and proactive demand intake with internal customers, connecting delivery plans, workload changes, and business growth to infrastructure needs.
* Develop headroom, runway, growth, and scenario models for data center and public cloud capacity, documenting assumptions, uncertainty, dependencies, and changes in demand.
* Validate sizing against production evidence, peak demand, failover conditions, and performance requirements, rather than treating average utilization as sufficient.
* Account for hardware lifecycle and procurement lead times, cloud quotas, regional availability, and provisioning constraints when developing timing and capacity options.
* Run a leadership-sponsored planning cadence, maintain clear analytical inputs, and escalate approved threshold crossings for review. Thresholds trigger discussion, not automatic purchases.
* Help drive FinOps discussions with existing FinOps engineers: facilitate consumption, demand, capacity, and cost conversations; support consumption and spend forecast scenarios; and follow up with agreed action owners without controlling their backlogs.
* Partner on rightsizing, reclamation, total cost of ownership, workload placement, and commitment analysis. Validate potential savings against resilience and performance needs; FinOps specialists retain ownership of their practice and program.

Requirements
  
  

* Five or more years of practical infrastructure engineering or operations experience, with the technical depth and independent judgment expected of a senior engineer. We welcome candidates whose experience has been built in infrastructure operations.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and business teams in a global environment. A minimum of four hours of daily overlap with the US Eastern business day is required.

Technical Requirements
  
  

* Practical understanding of virtualization, compute, operating systems, storage capacity and performance (IOPS, latency, and throughput), networks, and resilience. Experience with platforms such as VMware or Nutanix and Windows or Linux is relevant; specific vendors are not required.
* Ability to interpret observability and time-series data, assess public cloud capacity constraints, and build demand forecasts using Excel, SQL, Python, or equivalent data analysis tools.

**Working Experience with:**  

* Sizing production workloads and validating capacity assumptions against real telemetry, workload behavior, service objectives, and operational constraints.
* Translating cross-team demand into planning inputs and collaborating with globally distributed teams to resolve gaps, dependencies, and competing assumptions.

Must-Have Capabilities
  
  

* Personal, practical infrastructure depth: explain how resources, bottlenecks, failure modes, and workload behavior affect usable capacity.
* Translate customer demand into defensible forecasts and scenarios, clearly separating evidence, assumptions, uncertainty, and risks.
* Facilitate constructive stakeholder conversations, challenge weak assumptions respectfully, and apply sound technical judgment to capacity and cost trade-offs.
* Collaborate effectively with FinOps engineers and service owners, making cost-aware options understandable without compromising performance or resilience.

Role Summary

The Level 2 Managed Service Engineer for the End-to-End Observability team is responsible for advanced troubleshooting, root cause analysis, Datadog configuration, incident escalation, and continual service improvement across the observability stack. This role serves as the primary escalation point for L1 engineers and is expected to independently resolve, or drive resolution of, moderately complex incidents spanning application, infrastructure, network, APM, Synthetics, logs, and RUM data across both 3-tier and cloud-native environments.

Key Responsibilities

· Act as the first escalation point for incidents triaged by L1 engineers that require deeper investigation.

· Perform root cause analysis (RCA) by correlating APM traces, infrastructure metrics, network telemetry, logs, Synthetics results, and RUM data.

· Configure and fine-tune advanced Datadog capabilities: custom metrics, log pipelines, monitors with composite/anomaly detection, SLOs, and dashboards aligned to service ownership.

· Guide and review Datadog APM instrumentation coverage across services; identify monitoring gaps and recommend improvements.

· Independently identify whether an issue originates in the application tier, infrastructure, network, or a third-party dependency, in both 3-tier and cloud-native (microservices/containerized) environments.

· Lead or actively participate in major incident bridge calls, providing observability data to speed up resolution.

· Own problem management: identify recurring incidents, drive permanent fixes, and track them to closure.

· Mentor and coach L1 engineers on triage techniques, Datadog usage, and escalation quality.

· Contribute to automation of routine monitoring tasks (alert enrichment, auto-remediation triggers, ticket auto-creation).

· Support capacity and performance trend analysis using historical Datadog data.

· Review and refine monitors to reduce noise and false positives (alert tuning).

· Ensure adherence to SLAs/OLAs and maintain quality of incident documentation and RCA reports.

· Participate in client/stakeholder calls to explain incidents, trends, and improvement plans.

Required Skills and Experience

Observability Platform Skills

· 3 to 6 years of experience in Managed Services, NOC, SRE, or application/infrastructure support roles, with at least 1-2 years working hands-on with Datadog.

· Strong working knowledge of Datadog across monitoring, dashboards, alerting, APM, Synthetics, RUM, logs, metrics, SLOs, and service-level troubleshooting.

· Advanced monitor configuration (anomaly detection, forecast, composite monitors, SLOs).

· APM: distributed tracing, service maps, trace analytics, and identifying instrumentation gaps.

· Synthetics: designing multi-step API and browser tests, analyzing failure trends.

· RUM: correlating front-end performance and errors with backend traces.

· Log Management: building log pipelines, parsing rules, and log-based metrics.

· Solid understanding of infrastructure concepts: compute, storage, containers, orchestration (Kubernetes basics), and cloud resource scaling.

· Solid understanding of networking fundamentals: DNS, load balancing, latency/packet loss analysis, firewall and connectivity troubleshooting.

· Strong analytical ability to read application logs, stack traces, and error patterns to isolate the failing component, without needing to be an expert in the underlying code.

· Experience with ITSM tools for incident, problem, and change management.

· Working knowledge of ITIL processes, especially incident and problem management.

Application and Architecture Understanding

· Solid understanding of 3-tier application architecture and how load, latency, or failure at one tier cascades to others.

· Solid understanding of cloud-native architecture: microservices, containers, API gateways, service meshes, and inter-service communication patterns.

· Ability to correlate application-level symptoms (errors, latency, timeouts) with underlying infrastructure or network causes using observability data alone.

· Understanding of common resiliency patterns (retries, circuit breakers, caching, load balancing) and how their failure shows up in monitoring data.

Good to Have

· Datadog certification (APM, Infrastructure, or Log Management specialization).

· Scripting experience (Python, Shell, PowerShell) for automation and custom integrations.

· Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) for managing Datadog configuration as code.

· Experience with CI/CD pipelines and how deployments correlate with monitoring anomalies.

· Exposure to other observability or APM tools (New Relic, Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus).

Soft Skills

· Strong ownership and accountability for incident resolution.

· Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to both technical teams and stakeholders.

· Mentoring ability and patience when guiding L1 engineers.

· Comfortable leading discussions during high-pressure major incidents.

· Structured approach to documentation and knowledge sharing.

Education

· Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Work Details

· **Shift:** 24x7 rotational shifts, with on-call/escalation coverage as needed
